    Cartridge look

    Pick a skin. It restyles this page and is the look the cartridge carries. All twelve skins are on every cartridge: the player's options page switches between them, and “Start on” says which look it begins with.

    Click the preview, then use the arrow keys, Enter (A) and Esc (B), or the buttons above, to try the title page, menu and options.
